ws_tagging_policy.title: Tagging Policy
values: Only sync orders from the last 7 days (Order Date on or after 2026-01-22)
Orders with Notes indicating refund, cancellation, or chargeback must be excluded from sync
Orders with Notes indicating internal test must be excluded
Buyers listed in ws_marketing_optout must not be synced to any Mailchimp audience
